title: Broke before it got here
text: Broke before it got here. Blame it on the packaging or the quality, but one of the containers was broken when we opened the box. Glass everywhere. Nothing between the glass for transport. Glass seems thin, definitely too thin to ship without padding. Otherwise the sizing is perfect for what we need them for and the lids are fine.

product_metadata.title: Segarty Spice Jars, 6 Pack 3 oz Spice Bottles with Shaker Lids, Glass Empty Storage Containers with Adjustable Stainless Steel Flow Top for Your Regularly Used Spices
features: High Quality Glass: Made of glass, the material is sufficient, the bottle is solid and durable, Lead-free glass bottle, moisture-proof and anti corrosion. The inside condiment is clear at a glance.

3 Levels of Pouring: There are three kinds of holes on the top of cap, you can rotate it to adjust the hole size, easily control the condiment quantity.
Stylish Design: Add stylish design that adds charm to your kitchen. These spice jars are easy to use, easy to clean, and easily blend into the contemporary home.
